labels.description: 1-D `Tensor` of real labels for the classification task.

predictions.description: 1-D `Tensor` of predictions for a given classification.

num_classes.description: The possible number of labels the classification task can have. If this value is not provided, it will be calculated using both predictions and labels array.

dtype.description: Data type of the confusion matrix.

output.description: A `Tensor` of type `dtype` with shape `[n, n]` representing the confusion matrix, where `n` is the number of possible labels in the classification task.
